annotations.title: FIRE number and when you can retire

description: Use when a user asks when they can retire or how much they need to retire, e.g. "when can I retire if I invest $1,500 a month?", "what is my FIRE number if I spend $40,000 a year?" or "how many years until I can stop working?". Returns the FIRE number (yearly spending / withdrawal rate, 25 times spending at 4%) and, from current savings and a monthly contribution, the months and years to reach it and the age if current_age is given. Uses a real (after inflation) return, 7% by default; same math as the Compound Mint FIRE number calculator.

annual_return.description: Real yearly return percent after inflation (default 7).

annual_spending.description: Yearly spending in retirement in today's USD (or send fire_number).

current_age.description: Optional age now, to show the age you reach it.

fire_number.description: Total needed to retire in USD (instead of annual_spending).

name: calculate_fire_number
